answer_1.quote: We explore an alternative: characters and subwords as form‑based and more fine‑grained representations of both the input and output of the question generation task…
datasets: German QA answer corpus (De Kuthy et al.)

answer_2.quote: Table shows the BLEU scores from comparing the ground‑truth questions of the test set with corresponding model‑generated questions. We used the standard Sacre‑BLEU library.

answer_4.quote: The quality of the generated questions was manually evaluated by two human annotators, both trained linguists and native speakers of German. They were asked to provide a binary judgment: whether the question is well‑formed and satisfies question‑answer congruence with the source sentence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators gave a binary judgment based on (i) Well‑Formedness (grammaticality, spelling, word order) and (ii) Question‑Answer Congruence (answerability by the full source sentence).
